mechanism: Isoniazid may inhibit the metabolism of deutetrabenazine through CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 pathways, potentially increasing deutetrabenazine exposure and adverse effects including QT prolongation and CNS effects.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine adverse effects (involuntary movements, sedation, QT prolongation); consider ECG monitoring and dose adjustment if co-administration is necessary.
